title: join() keeps the delimiter's string buffer across a magical fetch that frees it
live_proof: upstream fixed it in e4be969235 (e4be96923581d9d10b5d3dd155992ed3706234cc) (2023-09-21). That commit is an ancestor of v5.45.3-85-gdb19522155 and is NOT an ancestor of the v5.36.3 tag (checked with git merge-base --is-ancestor, both directions), so it never reached the 5.36 maintenance branch; the pin's tree shows the unfixed code (pin doop.c:667 const char * const delims = SvPV_const(delim, delimlen); used at doop.c:708). Host ASan at the pin: ASan: heap-use-after-free (rc=77); the same trigger, same harness and same ASan options on master: no report (rc=0, the harness reports [PASS])
fidelity: the trigger is the test upstream added with its own fix, extracted onto a self-contained harness that collects failures instead of aborting, so one script yields one verdict. It is upstream's own reproduction, not a reduction of ours; what it does NOT establish is which arm ought to catch it
